instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-quality personal portfolio website for Vedanshkumar Gothi (Ved) using React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Lenis smooth scroll. Implement smoke-fog canvas background with reduced-motion fallback. Include Home, /work filterable grid, /work/:slug case study page, contact form saving submissions to backend, JSON-backed projects catalog, and accessibility standards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
